news.body: Shareholders will receive a dividend of ₹1.80. Ex-date: 25th June 2026 Payment date: 1st January 1970 Dividend yield will be 0.6%, which is about the same as the industry average. news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: Revenues exceed analysts expectations while EPS lags behind
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹10.30 (up from ₹9.92 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹45.5b (up 28% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹6.40b (up 6.5% from FY 2025).
